bio.text: Anna Paulina Luna represents Florida's 13th Congressional District in the U.S. House of Representatives and serves on the Oversight and Government Reform and Foreign Affairs committees.
She was raised in Southern California, served in the U.S. Air Force, and earned a bachelor's degree in biology from the University of West Florida.
She lives in St. Petersburg, Florida.
